trigger: Lolo's clinic. A notebook left open.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Lolo's clinic. She's asleep in her chair. A notebook open on the table, names in careful handwriting.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Mr. Pruitt is on the first page, if his oxygen ran out. A line through it. A date. Then more names.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Last page: IF IT COMES TO IT. The third name is Wes Pearce. His leg never healed clean.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: [Awake. Not pretending otherwise.] You found it. Good. Somebody should know.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: [Awake behind you] You found it. Good. Someone should know what this costs.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: I help people go, maitia. When it is time and there is nothing else. I write them down so it happened.

choices.text: You don't get to decide who goes.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: No? Then who? Avila? A soldier? You? At least I hold their hand.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: Nobody. That's the problem. So somebody who loves them does it. And then carries it.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: Your brother is strong. He'll probably never need that page. I write the page anyway.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: Burn it, then. I remember every name. The paper was for you, not me.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: She closes the notebook gently, like a door to a sleeping child's room.
